independent_acceptance.reasoning: The coefficient error is the same supported local Euler defect as M25-0021; Corollary 1 and the delta-uniform compactness estimates depend on companion I, supporting Major without claiming the existence theorem false. Separately, H^m does not embed in C^(m-1) on three-dimensional spacetime compact sets: the stated bump scaling is valid. The paper already supplies a uniform H^(m+1) bound; strong H^m convergence plus interpolation with 1/2<sigma<1 restores local C^(m-1) convergence. This actual-use repair supports the local Minor, with no claim uniform to t=0.
